title: coord_dedup over MCP fails against coord.py serve when the holder comes from KB_COORD_HOLDER: --holder lands after the question's --
goal: coord_dedup over MCP with KB_COORD_URL and KB_COORD_HOLDER set and no holder argument returns the dedup answer, not an argparse error

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,shutil
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();k=os.path.join(d,'keys');os.mkdir(k,0o700);f=os.path.join(k,'opa');open(f,'w').write('tok-opa-'+'0'*16+'\n');os.chmod(f,0o600)
p=s.Popen([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','serve','--store',os.path.join(d,'c.sqlite'),'--bind','127.0.0.1:0','--keys',k],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.PIPE,text=True)
ok=False
try:
    url=p.stdout.readline().strip().rpartition(' ')[2];e=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_URL=url,KB_COORD_KEY_FILE=f,KB_COORD_HOLDER='envh');e.pop('KB_COORD_STORE',None)
    m=[{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':0,'method':'initialize','params':{'protocolVersion':'2025-11-25','capabilities':{},'clientInfo':{'name':'c','version':'1'}}},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'notifications/initialized'},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'coord_dedup','arguments':{'question':'How does the Intune enrollment status page timeout work'}}}]
    r=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py'],input='\n'.join(map(json.dumps,m))+'\n',env=e,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=300)
    x=[json.loads(l) for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if json.loads(l).get('id')==1][0].get('result') or {}
    print(json.dumps(x)[:300]);ok=r.returncode==0 and not x.get('isError')
finally:
    p.terminate();p.wait(10);shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
